properties.site-address: Duchess’ High School, Howling Lane, Alnwick
properties.notes: Former school that has now been declared surplus following closure, with the site now cleared and available for redevelopment. Council-owned land with a proposal needing to be focussed on brownfield aspect of site, exclusive of the adjacent playing fields. Site allocated for residential development with an indicative yield of 60 dwellings through the Alnwick and Denwick Neighbourhood Plan (Site H2-3).
